title: Login fails with 'invalid token' after password reset
description: Users who reset their password are logged out and see 'invalid token' on the next login attempt. Old refresh tokens were not cleared.
resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0 by clearing refresh tokens on password reset. Ask the user to update the app.

title: Android app crashes when uploading large profile photo
description: Uploading a JPEG or PNG larger than about 5 MB from the gallery crashes the Android app with OutOfMemoryError. The image is decoded at full size before compression.
resolution: Open. Fix planned: downscale the image before upload. Workaround: crop the photo first.

title: Push notifications arrive twice on iOS
description: Every push notification is shown two times on iOS 17 because the device token is registered twice after an app update.
resolution: Fixed in 2.2.4 by de-duplicating device tokens on the server.

title: Timetable shows wrong times after daylight saving change
description: Lecture times are shifted by one hour for students whose phone timezone differs from the campus timezone.
resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0. Times are now stored in UTC and shown in the campus timezone.

title: Search returns no results for names with accents
description: Searching for a classmate named 'Jose' does not find 'José'. The search index does not normalise accented characters.
resolution: Open. Fix planned: normalise text to ASCII before indexing.

title: Web dashboard is blank in Safari
description: The student dashboard shows a white screen in Safari 16 because of an unsupported JavaScript regex feature.
resolution: Fixed in web release 5.1 by replacing the regex.

title: Assignment PDF upload stuck at 99 percent
description: Uploading assignment PDFs above 20 MB on slow networks stays at 99 percent and never finishes. The server request times out after 30 seconds.
resolution: Open. Fix planned: chunked uploads. Workaround: compress the PDF below 20 MB.

title: Attendance QR code scanner does not open camera
description: On some Android 14 phones the QR attendance scanner shows a black screen because camera permission is requested after the camera starts.
resolution: Open. Hotfix in progress. Students cannot mark attendance, so this is critical.

title: Dark mode makes timetable text unreadable
description: In dark mode the timetable uses dark grey text on a black background.
resolution: Open. Low priority UI fix: use theme text colour.

title: App logs out every time it is closed
description: The 'remember me' option is ignored and users must log in again every time they reopen the app.
resolution: Open. Session token is saved in memory instead of secure storage.
